name: Allen Fallauro
source:
Faction: Terran
Birthday: May 07, 2378
Place of Birth: Helios Capital City, Mars
Occupation: Gungnir Squad Ace
Affiliation: United Terran Vanguard
Voice Actor: N/A

Profile:
Lieutenant Commander Allen Fallauro is the ace of the Gungnir Squad, and has been good friends with Major Brookes. He believes in Jean’s decisions and they’re quite a formidable force when fighting together. Allen in comparison to Ashton, follows military protocol strictly. He is also a good adviser and deals with Terran racists accordingly which made him well known in the front line Vanguard forces. However because of his profile being Martian origin, he’s been suspected by a few individuals that he may eventually side with the Confederacy. Major Brookes also took care of this matter which strengthened the Gungnir squad’s kinship.
